subject: chunky mars rover
concept: A LEGO model of a chunky Mars rover with six rolling wheels, a boxy body, a raised camera mast, and a solar panel wing on each side.
features: six real rolling wheels on short axles
boxy stacked-brick body in grey with a red/gold accent stripe
raised camera mast with two round eye-like lenses
flat wedge-plate solar panels angled out on each side
simplifications: Kept the rover stationary on its wheels instead of mid-drive or tilted on rocky terrain, since dynamic poses aren't buildable
Made solar panels flat wedge plates instead of thin fragile panels, for a sturdy chunky build
Simplified the camera mast into a short chunky post topped with round tile eyes instead of a detailed instrument cluster
Reduced antenna to a single short bar instead of thin wiring or a dish arm, avoiding fragile thin parts
Used clean 3-color blocking (grey, gold, black) instead of realistic weathered metal textures
